header: Replays logged answer attempts (see answerLog.ts) through the CURRENT verification rules: no model, no network, no database. For each attempt it says what happened when it was logged and what happens now, so a change I make to the rules is proved on every real reply ever seen.

members.name: looseRows
doc: Rows of the answer that the current rules show as the assistant's own wording (their labels could not be tied to the document).

members.name: modelNote
doc: The note the model wrote, and the note the current rules show (the document's own sentence, or none).

behaviours: the fixture holds the three real replies of 18 Oct
REAL REPLIES: all three, refused when they were logged, are accepted by the current rules
...the gift card with its labels tied to the document, the mediclaim and sports answers with the assistant's own wording marked
each row says what happened when it was logged
the replay shows a grounded note as the document's sentence, next to the model's own
a half-written last line is skipped
an attempt logged as accepted and refused now is counted as a regression
an unreadable model reply is a refusal, not a crash
an attempt with a model reply is logged, one JSON line each, in a folder made on demand
an attempt with no model reply (nothing to replay) is not logged
a log that cannot be written never throws
